name: Ethio Walia Soccer Club
story: Established in Toronto in 2017, Ethio-Walia brings together the Ethiopian and Eritrean communities through soccer. We are a non-profit club focused on competitive soccer, player development, teamwork, leadership and positive community involvement.
history: Our competitive history includes the TSSL Championship in 2021 and several cup and tournament victories. We are seeking district membership to continue developing in a structured, competitive environment.
mission: Provide structured soccer opportunities, develop players with experienced coaching, and build lasting partnerships within our local soccer community.
